verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Cloudflare documents an official MCP server on its agent-setup page, so an agent can connect to Cloudflare through an official MCP server. That evidence is platform-wide, though, and nothing shows the server exposes Registrar operations; the Registrar API and OpenAPI spec suggest those operations could be reachable. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server covers Registrar domain search/registration/management, setup and authentication details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
